description: This file is a shell script that provides command-line functions for managing OCI containers, including start, stop, list, info, pause, resume, and execute commands via curl with JSON RPC. It includes functions for starting containers from bundles or specs, as well as a command loop interface.

methods.name: start_container_from_bundle
methods.description: Starts an OCI container from a specified bundle path or name, possibly extracting a tarball if needed, and sends a JSON RPC request via curl.

methods.name: start_container_from_spec
methods.description: Starts an OCI container from a Dobby spec JSON file, sending a JSON RPC request.

methods.name: stop_container
methods.description: Stops a running container by sending a JSON RPC request.

methods.name: get_container_info
methods.description: Retrieves info for a specific container.

methods.name: get_container_state
methods.description: Retrieves the current state of a specified container.

methods.name: execute_command
methods.description: Executes a command inside a container with optional parameters.

methods.name: ocicontainer_help
methods.description: Displays available commands and usage information.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main command loop that reads user input and invokes functions accordingly.
